title: WooCommerce context-free widget (woocommerce-cart) inside a container — the FREE-context place-anywhere case
_comment: WP-R06 Pro WooCommerce fixture (10-rest-api.md §8.8; SUPPLEMENT §A.5). A classic `woocommerce-cart` widget (category woocommerce-elements → context 'free') nested under a flex container. The Woo_Context_Validator classifies this widget 'free' → required_doc_types() = [] → context validation is SKIPPED → context_ok:true on ANY doc type (page, single, archive). POST /pro/woo/add-widget places it without a context error regardless of the target document type. requires.woocommerce note: WooCommerce + the Pro Woo module must be active OR this widget is unregistered (UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE) → the runner SKIPS the fixture; WooCommerce is NOT installed on the live dev site.
_requires_note: Also requires WooCommerce (the WC plugin) AND the Elementor Pro WooCommerce module to be active; SKIP when woo-not-active. The harness has no native `woocommerce` requires flag (Contract 14 §2), so this note + pro:true gate the fixture.
